items.title: About Dr. William Glasser: A History of His Life and Work
items.rights_note: WGI's current founder history documents the sequence Reality Therapy to Control Theory to Choice Theory; it is an interested institutional account, not independent historiography.

items.title: Reality Therapy: A New Approach to Psychiatry
items.rights_note: Open Library record for the 1965 Harper & Row edition; preview-only availability does not authorize caching or treating the book body as read.

items.title: Reality Therapy: The WDEP System
items.rights_note: Wubbolding's WDEP method paper appears at the end of an ERIC-hosted 1992 international counseling conference proceedings volume; it is a proponent-authored method source, not independent outcome evidence.
items.failure_note: The preferred independent 2015 Wiley handbook summary returned an 'Error - Cookies Turned Off' shell to the collector; it was removed and this ERIC full method paper selected without bypassing site controls.

items.title: Effects of Teacher Training in Disciplinary Approaches
items.rights_note: ERIC full report independently reviews Reality Therapy among four school discipline approaches and records mixed or null student outcomes plus design and attribution limits; its scope is educational implementation, not psychotherapy generally.

items.title: Choice Theory/Reality Therapy for Children with Disruptive Behavior
items.rights_note: Independent state policy institute program record for a specific nine-session parent intervention; it must not be generalized to adult psychotherapy, other protocols, or Choice Theory as a personality theory.

items.title: Group Interventions Based on Reality Therapy for Adolescents and Young Adults: Systematic Review
items.rights_note: Turkish open systematic review screening Turkish and English studies from 2010-2021; eight included group-intervention studies, heterogeneous outcomes and youth samples prevent general efficacy conclusions.

items.title: Meta-analysis of the Effectiveness of Reality Therapy Group Counseling Programs to Improve Self-esteem in Adolescents
items.rights_note: KCI Korean/English abstract and bibliographic record for a meta-analysis of 16 Korean adolescent self-esteem programs; regional publication and narrow outcome are context boundaries, not cross-cultural equivalence evidence.

items.title: About William Glasser International
items.rights_note: Current WGI self-description of certification, member organizations and international activity; institutional continuation does not validate theory or clinical outcomes. Its standards claims are not a publicly inspectable adverse-event or contraindication guideline.
